headline: Hidalgo County Power Backup Report
summary: Homes in Hidalgo County face a long outage about once every 8 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 16% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 78 hours. In July 2020, 20% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 24 hours. One Core lasts about 20 hours in August. One Core lasts about 51 hours in February. Two Cores last about 40 hours in August. Two Cores cover 88% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
